moments.author: Marcus Smart
moments.quote: Threw a punch at Charles Bassey and got hit with a Flagrant 2 and ejected.
moments.why: This violent on‑court ejection is dominating sports talk across social for its shock value and fallout.

moments.author: Stephen Curry
moments.quote: Left game vs. Rockets early with right abdominal soreness.
moments.why: Curry’s injury in the first quarter sent ripples through NBA fandom overnight.

moments.author: Jensen Huang
moments.quote: A meme template asks: "the last thing Sam Altman saw before leaking gpt‑7 weights to the CCP"—went viral.
moments.why: The CEO scandal sparked a flood of memes mocking AI execs amid national‑security concerns.

moments.author: Charles Bassey
moments.quote: Smart’s ‘fake toughness’ — he was playing dirty the whole game.
moments.why: Bassey’s savage post‑fight takedown tweet added fuel to the melee’s viral momentum.

moments.author: Steve Kerr
moments.quote: Concern is high after Curry exits with abdominal soreness; he left for an MRI.
moments.why: The coach’s alarm added gravity to the developing injury story.
